facts.fact: StackAdapt says it earned a spot on G2's 2024 Best Software Awards for the 5th time.
facts.quote: This is StackAdapt’s 5th time receiving G2’s Best Software Award recognition, earning its place this year

facts.fact: G2 states it is visited by 90 million software buyers each year (G2's own figure, repeated in the release).
facts.quote: As the world’s largest and most trusted software marketplace, G2 is visited by 90 million software buyers each year.

facts.fact: G2 states that more than 90 million buyers visit its site each year, more than any other B2B marketplace.
facts.quote: G2 attracts more than 90 million buyers to our site each year—more than any other B2B marketplace

facts.fact: G2 says fewer than 1% of vendors listed on G2 made one of its 30+ 2024 Best Software Award lists.
facts.quote: Congratulations to the less than 1% of vendors listed on G2 who made one of our 30+ lists this year

facts.fact: G2's 2024 Best Software Awards feature more than 30 different lists ranking vendors using G2's proprietary algorithm.
facts.quote: G2’s 2024 Best Software Awards feature more than 30 different lists, ranking software vendors and products using G2’s proprietary algorithm

facts.fact: To be eligible for G2's Best Software Awards, a software company or product must have received at least 50 approved reviews during the 2023 calendar year.
facts.quote: a software company or product must have received at least 50 approved reviews during the 2023 calendar year.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes itself as used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a multi-channel programmatic advertising platform used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.

facts.fact: G2 states that employees at all Fortune 500 companies use G2 to make software decisions.
facts.quote: including employees at all Fortune 500 companies — use G2 to make smarter software decisions based on authentic peer reviews.
